title: Safety Through Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Reasoning Guardrail Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of training reasoning-based guardrail models for content moderation. While the taxonomies used include categories like 'Immoral/Unethical' and 'Hate/Identity Hate', the study does not evaluate or benchmark religion, specific religious traditions, or provide a deep exploration of ethical/moral reasoning frameworks beyond their use as safety classification labels.
